title: पञ्चमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 5 · Dhritarashtra asks about the earth

summary.en: After Vyasa leaves, Dhritarashtra reflects on the war and asks Sanjaya why men fight so greedily over the earth. He asks Sanjaya to describe the beings and lands of the world.
summary.kn: ವ್ಯಾಸರು ಹೋದ ಬಳಿಕ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ಯುದ್ಧದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಂತಿಸಿ ಭೂಮಿಗಾಗಿ ಮನುಷ್ಯರು ಇಷ್ಟು ಲೋಭದಿಂದ ಏಕೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆಂದು ಸಂಜಯನನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಲೋಕದ ಜೀವಿಗಳನ್ನೂ ಭೂಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳನ್ನೂ ವರ್ಣಿಸಲು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास के जाने पर धृतराष्ट्र युद्ध पर विचार करते हैं और संजय से पूछते हैं कि मनुष्य पृथ्वी के लिए इतने लोभ से क्यों लड़ते हैं। वे संसार के प्राणियों और भूभागों का वर्णन करने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: వ్యాసుడు వెళ్ళాక ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు యుద్ధం గురించి ఆలోచించి భూమి కోసం మనుషులు ఇంత లోభంతో ఎందుకు పోరాడుతారని సంజయుని అడుగుతాడు. లోకంలోని జీవులను, భూభాగాలను వివరించమంటాడు.
summary.ta: வியாசர் சென்றபின் த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் போரைப் பற்றி எண்ணி, மனிதர்கள் நிலத்துக்காக ஏன் இவ்வளவு பேராசையுடன் போரிடுகிறார்கள் என்று சஞ்சயனிடம் கேட்கிறான். உலகின் உயிர்களையும் நிலப்பகுதிகளையும் விவரிக்கச் சொல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: വ്യാസൻ പോയശേഷം ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ യുദ്ധത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് ആലോചിക്കുന്നു; ഭൂമിക്കുവേണ്ടി മനുഷ്യർ ആർത്തിയോടെ പോരാടുന്നത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്ന് സഞ്ജയനോട് ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ലോകത്തിലെ ജീവികളെയും ദേശങ്ങളെയും വിവരിക്കാൻ അദ്ദേഹം സഞ്ജയനോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.5; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ व्यासो धृतराष्ट्राय धीमते ।
धृतराष्ट्रोऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken thus, Vyasa went away from the wise Dhritarashtra; and Dhritarashtra, having heard him, fell into thought again.

verses.text:
स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा विनिःश्वस्य मुहुर्मुहुः ।
संजयं संशितात्मानमपृच्छद्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: After brooding for a moment and sighing again and again, O best of the Bharatas, he questioned the firm-minded Sanjaya.

verses.text:
संजयेमे महीपालाः शूरा युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ।
अन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नन्ति शस्त्रैरुच्चावचैरपि ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, these heroic kings, delighting in battle, strike one another down with weapons of every kind.

verses.text:
पार्थिवाः पृथिवीहेतोः समभित्यक्तजीविताः ।
न च शाम्यन्ति निघ्नन्तो वर्धयन्तो यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: For the sake of the earth the kings have cast away their lives, and they do not cease killing, only increasing the abode of Yama.

verses.text:
भौममैश्वर्यमिच्छन्तो न मृष्यन्ते परस्परम् ।
मन्ये बहुगुणा भूमिस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: Desiring lordship over the earth they cannot tolerate each other. I think the earth has many virtues; tell me about it, Sanjaya.

verses.text:
बहूनि च सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च ।
कोट्यश्च लोकवीराणां समेताः कुरुजाङ्गले ॥

meaning.en: Many thousands, myriads, millions and tens of millions of the world's heroes have gathered in the land of Kuru-Jangala.

verses.text:
देशानां च परीमाणं नगराणां च संजय ।
श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन यत एते समागताः ॥

meaning.en: I wish to hear truly the extent of the countries and cities from which these have come.

verses.text:
दिव्यबुद्धिप्रदीपेन युक्तस्त्वं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
प्रसादात्तस्य विप्रर्षेर्व्यासस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: You are endowed with the lamp of divine understanding and the eye of knowledge, by the grace of the Brahmin sage Vyasa of boundless power.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
यथाप्रज्ञं महाप्राज्ञ भौमान्वक्ष्यामि ते गुणान् ।
शास्त्रचक्षुरवेक्षस्व नमस्ते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Greatly wise one, I will describe to you the qualities of the earth as my understanding allows; look with the eye of scripture. Homage to you, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
द्विविधानीह भूतानि त्रसानि स्थावराणि च ।
त्रसानां त्रिविधा योनिरण्डस्वेदजरायुजाः ॥

meaning.en: There are two kinds of beings here, the moving and the unmoving; the moving have three origins: egg-born, sweat-born and womb-born.

verses.text:
त्रसानां खलु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठा राजञ्जरायुजाः ।
जरायुजानां प्रवरा मानवाः पशवश्च ये ॥

meaning.en: King, of all the moving beings the womb-born are the best, and among the womb-born the best are humans and the beasts.

verses.text:
नानारूपाणि बिभ्राणास्तेषां भेदाश्चतुर्दश ।
अरण्यवासिनः सप्त सप्तैषां ग्रामवासिनः ॥

meaning.en: Bearing many forms, they have fourteen kinds: seven live in the forest and seven in the village.

verses.text:
सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाश्च महिषा वारणास्तथा ।
ऋक्षाश्च वानराश्चैव सप्तारण्याः स्मृता नृप ॥

meaning.en: Lion, tiger, boar, buffalo, elephant, bear and monkey are remembered as the seven of the forest, King.

verses.text:
गौरजो मनुजो मेषो वाज्यश्वतरगर्दभाः ।
एते ग्राम्याः समाख्याताः पशवः सप्त साधुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Cow, goat, human, sheep, horse, mule and donkey are declared by the wise to be the seven domestic animals.

verses.text:
एते वै पशवो राजन्ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश ।
वेदोक्ताः पृथिवीपाल येषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: These, King, the fourteen domestic and wild animals, are those named in the Veda, in which sacrifices are founded.

verses.text:
ग्राम्याणां पुरुषः श्रेष्ठः सिंहश्चारण्यवासिनाम् ।
सर्वेषामेव भूतानामन्योन्येनाभिजीवनम् ॥

meaning.en: Among domestic animals the human is best, and among forest-dwellers the lion; all beings live by one another.

verses.text:
उद्भिज्जाः स्थावराः प्रोक्तास्तेषां पञ्चैव जातयः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्ल्यस्त्वक्सारास्तृणजातयः ॥

meaning.en: Beings born from the earth are called unmoving, and they have five kinds only: trees, shrubs, creepers, vines, and those with bark and grasses.

verses.text:
एषां विंशतिरेकोना महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु ।
चतुर्विंशतिरुद्दिष्टा गायत्री लोकसंमता ॥

meaning.en: Of these there are nineteen kinds, and with the five great elements the count is twenty-four, which is the Gayatri honoured by the world.

verses.text:
य एतां वेद गायत्रीं पुण्यां सर्वगुणान्विताम् ।
तत्त्वेन भरतश्रेष्ठ स लोकान्न प्रणश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Best of the Bharatas, whoever truly knows this holy Gayatri, endowed with every virtue, is not lost from the worlds.

verses.text:
भूमौ हि जायते सर्वं भूमौ सर्वं प्रणश्यति ।
भूमिः प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां भूमिरेव परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: Everything is born on the earth and everything perishes on the earth; the earth is the support of beings and she alone is their final refuge.

verses.text:
यस्य भूमिस्तस्य सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
तत्राभिगृद्धा राजानो विनिघ्नन्तीतरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: All the world, moving and unmoving, belongs to whoever holds the earth; greedy for it, the kings strike one another down.
